tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(daemon): cap Pipeline.Body at creation, fix nil-tools Bash assumption

Copilot review findings:

- Executor.Run now caps Body at maxContractFieldRunes when the pipeline
  is created, matching the cap buildStageContract already applies before
  the value reaches a worker's mission contract. Storing the uncapped
  body was wasted disk/memory and a potential DoS vector from oversized
  emails.
- BuildSystemPromptForTools no longer treats nil tools as "Bash is
  available". spawner.go's Run already treats nil/empty tools as
  granting none of the built-in tools (--tools ""), so the system
  prompt now agrees: nil tools omits the "ethos mission result" shell
  instruction, matching the same fix already applied for the empty-slice
  case (beadle-vr0v).

Updated the doc comments on both functions to describe the corrected
behavior, and fixed/added tests: TestBuildSystemPrompt now exercises the
full instruction set via an explicit Bash grant, and a new
TestBuildSystemPromptNilToolsOmitsBashDependentResult locks in the
nil-tools case directly.
EOF
)"
